message: I think I have finally gotten a handle on this.  After all the garbage excuses including my husband put a block on the phone in June (he died 3-12-06) she finally told me the truth as she knows it.  My son makes the collect call.  I get billed for it on my monthly bill.  At that time I owe 25.00 or thereabouts.  My phone company gets the money.  They pay Embarq who in turn pays Correctional billing.  As soon as correctional gets the money they release the block.  My son calls and before I am even billed for the call another block is put on my phone.  Because this is political and the sh-- hit the fan and exposed all the excessive charges for calls they want to switch everyone to a prepaid calling card.  Under the collect method - my son can only call collect once every 3 mos.  I guess we can look at this a different way.  The state has to have the money from somewhere.  Otherwise services are the lst to go.  It is another tax!!  They are losing a ton of money in collect phone call fees and the state and local taxes on the phone calls.  Hope they straighten it out soon.
